fields.body_md:
## At a glance

The University of Warwick teaches one-year master's courses in computing, statistics and management, plus a full-time MBA. Its courses are taught on the University of Warwick campus. For a 2027 start, overseas tuition for the MSc Computer Science is **£39,330** for the year. That is the number to plan around first.

| | MSc Computer Science | MSc Statistics with Data Science | Full-time MBA | MSc Management |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tuition for 2027-28 | **£39,330** (overseas) | **£39,330** (overseas) | **£62,500** (all students) | **£41,500** (overseas) |
| Length | 1 year, full-time | 1 year, full-time | 12 or 16 months | 1 year, full-time |
| IELTS (overall score) | 6.5 | 6.5 | 7.0 | 7.0 |
| Start date | 27 September 2027 | 27 September 2027 | 27 September 2027 | 27 September 2027 |

Warwick does not have a course called Data Science. The closest match is the **MSc Statistics with Data Science**.

## What it really costs

### Tuition

Overseas tuition for 2027-28 is **£39,330** for MSc Computer Science and for MSc Statistics with Data Science. The full-time MBA is **£62,500**, and this fee is the same for every student. The MSc Management is **£41,500** for overseas students.

### Money you must show for the visa

A UK student visa asks you to prove you can support yourself. Outside London, you must show **£1,171 for each month** of your course, for up to 9 months. For a 9-month course that is £1,171 × 9 = **£10,539**.

You must hold this money for 28 days in a row. The end of that 28-day period must fall within 31 days of the day you apply.

### Visa and health fees

- **Student visa application fee** for applying from outside the UK: **£558**.
- **Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS)**: a payment that covers your use of UK healthcare during your visa. For students it is **£776 for each year of your visa**.

### Worked first year: MSc Computer Science

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition, 2027-28 | £39,330 |
| Money to show for the visa: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £776 or more |
| **Total** | **at least £51,203** |

The sum is £39,330 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 = £51,203, which is the minimum. Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164. Treat this as a starting estimate for one course. It does not include flights, rent or your everyday spending.

Read how the visa works in our [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare costs at other UK universities, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Ways to reduce the cost

Warwick lists its scholarships on its own scholarships page. Check that page for awards you may qualify for, and for their deadlines, before you plan your budget. The [Warwick scholarships page](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/scholarships-and-bursaries/scholarships/) is the place to start.

## Getting in

Each course has its own entry rule.

- **MSc Computer Science:** a First Class Honours degree or a high 2:1 undergraduate degree. A 2:1 is an upper second-class honours degree. The subject should be Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or another relevant quantitative degree.
- **MSc Statistics with Data Science:** a 2:1 undergraduate degree, or equivalent, in Statistics, Mathematics or a science with high mathematical content.
- **Full-time MBA:** at least three years of post-graduate professional business experience. A 2:2 degree is preferred but not essential.

Indian students should read Warwick's [India entry requirements page](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/international/countryinformation/southasia/india/india-entry-requirements/). It says the minimum score depends on your institution, so check it against your own college.

**English:** Warwick asks for IELTS (International English Language Testing System), an English test.

- MSc Computer Science and MSc Statistics with Data Science: **IELTS 6.5 overall**, with no part below **6.0**.
- Full-time MBA: **IELTS 7.0 overall**, with at least **6.0** in each of the four parts.
- MSc Management: **IELTS 7.0 overall**.

## Deadlines

| Course | Start date | On-time application deadline |
|---|---|---|
| MSc Computer Science | 27 September 2027 | 2 August 2027 |
| MSc Statistics with Data Science | 27 September 2027 | 2 August 2027 |
| Full-time MBA | 27 September 2027 | 30 May 2027 for international applicants (the MBA runs its own rounds; the last is 1 August 2027) |
| MSc Management | 27 September 2027 | 2 August 2027 |

The 2 August 2027 date is the on-time deadline for the three MSc courses starting in September or October 2027. The Full-time MBA has its own application system and rounds through Warwick Business School. Late applications are still accepted, but Warwick cannot promise a decision in time.

**Apply early, because of the visa.** Your visa application needs a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) from your course provider, which is Warwick. You can apply for the student visa up to 6 months before your course starts. Gov.uk says a decision usually takes 3 weeks if you apply from outside the UK.

Some courses also need an **ATAS certificate** (Academic Technology Approval Scheme), which you must have before you start. Indian nationals need one only if their course requires it. ATAS can take 8 to 10 weeks, so ask Warwick early whether your course needs one.

## Courses covered on this page

These four Warwick courses are the ones this page covers. Each one has its own course page with the full details:

- [MSc Computer Science](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/courses/msc-computer-science/)
- [MSc Statistics with Data Science](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/courses/msc-statistics-data-science/)
- [Full-time MBA](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/courses/mba-full-time-mba/)
- [MSc Management](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/courses/msc-management/)

The full-time MBA runs as a 12-month or 16-month course. The 16-month format has an extension fee of **£1,250**.

## Where you'll live

Warwick's [accommodation page](https://warwick.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/whywarwick/accommodation/) describes the housing options for postgraduate students. Check it for room types, prices and application dates before you plan your budget.

## Who it's a good fit for

**A strong choice if:**

- You have a First Class or high 2:1 degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or a similar subject, and you want a one-year computing master's.
- You have a 2:1 in Statistics, Mathematics or a science with high mathematical content, and you want a data-focused master's.
- You have at least three years of post-graduate business experience and want an MBA.

**Think carefully if:**

- Your degree is not in one of the subjects listed for MSc Computer Science.
- You have less than three years of post-graduate business experience, because the MBA requires it.
- You cannot show £10,539 in living money for the visa.

To compare Warwick with other options, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

faq_json.q: How much is tuition at Warwick for Indian students?
faq_json.a: For 2027-28, overseas tuition is £39,330 for MSc Computer Science and for MSc Statistics with Data Science. The full-time MBA is £62,500 for every student.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score do I need for Warwick?
faq_json.a: For MSc Computer Science and MSc Statistics with Data Science you need IELTS 6.5 overall, with no part below 6.0. The full-time MBA needs IELTS 7.0 overall, with at least 6.0 in each of the four parts.

faq_json.q: What is the Warwick application deadline for September 2027?
faq_json.a: The on-time deadline for the three MSc courses starting in September or October 2027 is 2 August 2027. The Full-time MBA has its own rounds: the international deadline is 30 May 2027 and the last round is 1 August 2027. Late applications are still accepted, but Warwick cannot promise a decision in time.

faq_json.q: Does the Warwick MBA need work experience?
faq_json.a: Yes. You need at least three years of post-graduate professional business experience. A 2:2 degree is preferred but not essential.

faq_json.q: How much money do I need to show for a Warwick master's visa?
faq_json.a: For a course outside London you show £1,171 for each month, for up to 9 months. For MSc Computer Science that is £10,539. You must hold the money for 28 days in a row.
